title: Former Crestwood administrator's death being investigated as murder-suicide - NewsBreak
text:
By Staff Report ,
20 hours ago Margaret Foster, Crestwood’s former high school principal, holds up a book during a graduation speech. Times Leader File Photo A former Crestwood School District administrator was shot and killed by her husband inside her home in Susquehanna County on Tuesday, according to Susquehanna County Acting Coroner Jessica Chiaramonte and the Pennsylvania State Police.
Margaret “Peg” Foster, 60, and Andrew Kelemen, 61, were found dead inside the home from gunshot wounds, the coroner said.
According to a PSP news release, state police were contacted by a local pastor requesting a welfare check on Foster and Kelemen after being unable to reach them.
“The pastor advised that the individuals had recently been experiencing personal difficulties related to a separation and pending divorce,” the release states.
“Troopers responded to the residence and observed an open rear sliding glass door. After receiving no response to verbal contact, troopers entered the home and located Foster and Kelemen deceased in the living room.
“Preliminary investigation determined that Kelemen fatally shot Foster before taking his own life. The Pennsylvania State Police Major Case Team was activated, and the Forensic Services Unit responded to process the scene.”
